As a engineer in this team, you will be responsible to create this platform from the ground up — working closely with customers, industry experts and leadership to define its architecture, lead its development and ultimately deliver a scalable digital solution that shorten design cycles, drive procurement, improve on-site installation/commissioning and ultimately drive us towards our ambition of delivering fully automated MHS design. Your scope extends across design automation, PLM integration, data flow to manufacturing systems, real-time validation via simulation and generation of install documentation as well as building baseline PLC configuration. The goal: to transform how Amazon does design, test, procurement and delivery in order to bring new fulfillment technologies and sites online faster, safer, and smarter.

- You will own problem definition and solution design, working to gain deep understanding of the problem space by working with stakeholders and design engineer to understand the current "state of the art" and opportunities for improvement.

- Evaluate the existing market for CAD and PLM tools, determining Amazon's requirements of them and identifying the ones best suited to be the foundation of our product. 
- Design Tooling Development Establish the source of truth for Amazon’s material handing equipment engineering standards, design constraints, and equipment specifications that will be the foundation of the system. 
- Develop APIs and services that bridge the gaps in commercial tooling and enable automatic layout, BOMs, device configuration generation. 
- Build a digital feedback loop linking design models to performance data from real-world fielded systems. 
- Create a framework linking MHS designs with the simulation and emulation tools that power load/capacity testing, validation and virtual commissioning before the hardware ever lands on-site. 
- Partner with mechanical, electrical, and controls engineers to ensure our automation aligns with real world installation and commissioning needs.
- Unified Platform Development Defining and developing the end-to-end architecture for Amazon’s digital design tools and PLM ecosystem for MHS.

- Work on Tier-1 systems with direct impact on Amazon's global transaction infrastructure from day one
- Be part of a team at the forefront of GenAI in payments, building AI-first tools that redefine how financial offers are created and delivered
- Gain hands-on experience with AI DLC development integrated into a system processing trillions of requests annually
- Learn from and collaborate with Principal Engineers, Senior TPMs, and world-class engineers in Seattle
- Grow your career in a team that values technical depth, ownership, and AI-driven innovation
- Shape payment architecture across worldwide marketplaces and 20+ payment products

Let us build the AI-powered payment systems that power Amazon's future.

- Develop and maintain backend services

- Optimize system performance for high-traffic applications

- Design and develop features for the Investment Management System using Python (Flask) backend and TypeScript (React) frontend, ensuring code quality and maintainability

- Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, helping maintain high-quality systems while working collaboratively with senior engineers
- Support operational excellence by identifying and resolving issues, documenting solutions, and ensuring the platform serves as the single source of truth for Amazon's investment data

A day in the life

Throughout the day, you'll engage with stakeholders to clarify requirements, demo new features, or troubleshoot data discrepancies. You'll navigate the ambiguity of evolving finance business requirements, translating them into technical specifications. You might contribute to AWS serverless components powering data flows between systems, participate in code reviews, or spend time self-directing your learning to rapidly onboard and contribute.

About the team
Our small, high-ownership team consists of one Software Development Manager, one Senior Software Development Engineer, one Software Development Engineer, and one Senior Data Engineer. Working within Corporate Development Finance, we build and maintain the critical systems that track Amazon's corporate investment and warrant portfolios.

Every engineer on our team has direct influence over architectural decisions, roadmap priorities, and platform direction. There's minimal bureaucratic overhead, meaning your work ships quickly and your impact is immediately visible. We value collaboration, independent problem-solving, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while delivering high-quality solutions for our finance stakeholders.

This role offers hands-on experience with AWS services, GPU cluster provisioning, and cross-functional collaboration in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Core Responsibilities

Software Development

 * Develop and maintain components of the Multi-Asset Provisioning Service workflows for UltraServer hosts
* Write clean, maintainable code with appropriate unit tests and participate in code reviews
* Implement automation for hardware testing, cable validation, and provisioning processes
* Build observable systems with metrics and alarms under guidance from senior engineers

System Implementation

* Implement solutions designed by senior engineers for cross-functional Manufacturing, Operations, and Program Management needs
* Work with AWS native services to build scalable infrastructure frameworks
* Support network partition configurations for multi-node GPU clusters

Operational Support

* Monitor and troubleshoot UltraServer provisioning workflows
* Investigate workflow failures and coordinate with downstream teams for resolution
* Respond to operational issues and contribute to root cause analysis
 * Help identify operational inefficiencies and propose improvements

Hardware & Software Integration

* Work with hardware and software integrations for GPU clusters and AI/ML training systems
* Support testing and validation of UltraServer components
* Learn and apply domain knowledge about GPU infrastructure and networking

Team Collaboration

 * Collaborate with team members, stakeholders, and partner teams to understand requirements
 * Participate actively in code reviews, design discussions, and technical assessments
 * Communicate progress, blockers, and technical decisions effectively
 * Contribute to team documentation and knowledge sharing

About the team
The EC2 UltraServer Provisioning team is a high-performing engineering organization responsible for delivering NVIDIA-based ML infrastructure at scale. We manage end-to-end provisioning workflows for GB200 and GB300 UltraServers, from host ingestion through testing, repair, and recovery. Our team drives operational excellence through continuous improvement of build quality metrics, reduction of dwell times, and collaboration on fleet-wide unsellable reduction initiatives. We work closely with hardware engineering, data center operations, and EC2 service teams to ensure reliable, efficient delivery of critical ML compute capacity. This is a high-impact role leading a two-pizza team of talented engineers solving complex technical challenges in one of Amazon's fastest-growing infrastructure domains.

description:
EC2 Managed AWS Geographic Expansion is the team responsible to build one of Earth's largest distributed systems - EC2 - at scale. We own the software and tooling to build the foundation of the cloud in new Regions and Availability zones and our team is growing to support a senior leadership strategic initiative.

AWS is the industry leader in Cloud Computing. We enable our customers to dynamically scale their computing capacity as needed. They sky is the limit! You will have the opportunity to implement tooling that interacts with a broad set of EC2 services ensuring we can build one EC2 at scale. We create the tools needed to deploy new EC2 in a fully automated fashion with zero human touch. This work requires innovative solutions for managing complex large scale deployments including configuration, service migration, dependency detection and management and more.

Inclusive Team Culture 
 
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust. 

Not all applicants have skills that match qualifications exactly. We encourage applicants with alternative experience to also apply.

Work/Life Balance 

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. 

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice. 
   
Mentorship & Career Growth 

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. 

A day in the life
SDEs on EC2 Managed AWS Geographic Expansion balance their time writing / shipping code, designing new systems / components to solve complex technical / business problems, mentoring others, responding to operational events, and having fun!

We apply agile-scrum methodologies to our development approach with daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. Engineers have regular 1:1s with their managers to set goals and track career progression.  

We work closely with every foundational AWS service teams including S3, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS, and SWF to deliver capabilities to enable zero-touch region build.

About the team
The EC2 Managed AWS Geographic Expansion team was formed 7 years ago to tackle the unique and complex technical challenges that arise from building new AWS Regions & Availability Zones. Many of the tenured Amazonians who formed this team are still on it today. 

Our engineers enjoy the ability to work broadly across all the services that comprise EC2 and Dive Deep into the complexities of automating the instantiation of a massive distributed system. 

We have fun with regular happy hours, AmA sessions, and team outings. We work as a team and support our collective learning and growth.

We own critical infrastructure including event-based data stores, machine learning training platforms, and data access interfaces that enable responsible AI development while maintaining the highest standards of privacy, security, and compliance. Our platform serves as the backbone for storing, processing, and managing data that fuels AI-powered capabilities across AWS, ensuring customers retain full control over their information.

As a Software Development Engineer I, you'll contribute to production systems that handle the complete data lifecycle—from ingestion through model training to customer opt-out controls. You'll develop software components and implement well-defined features while learning from senior engineers and participating in code reviews. Working alongside scientists and engineers, you'll enable them to build and improve AI models while gaining experience with compliance requirements and software engineering best practices.

This role offers exciting opportunities to solve complex challenges around secure data storage, efficient querying at scale, and building self-service platforms that empower development teams. You'll drive the evolution of established platforms to meet future needs, directly impacting how AWS delivers increasingly sophisticated AI-powered capabilities while ensuring customers maintain complete control over their data throughout every stage of processing.

Key job responsibilities
Develop and implement software components for event-based data storage systems, working with well-defined specifications and seeking guidance from senior engineers when facing complex technical decisions or integration challenges 

Contribute to maintenance and enhancement of existing storage and analytics platform by implementing improvements, bug fixes, and performance optimizations within established architectural patterns 

Write high-quality, well-tested code for data access interfaces and authorization systems, ensuring implementations meet Amazon's code bar for correctness, maintainability, and security while following team standards 

Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing by providing feedback on code changes, learning from senior engineers through technical discussions, and documenting your implementations to enable understanding by other team members 

Support troubleshooting and resolution of software issues in components you've worked on, participate in operational support rotations to learn production systems, and assist with diagnosing problems while escalating complex issues appropriately 

Collaborate with team members to understand requirements from business application teams, translating well-defined specifications into working code that balances customer needs with platform sustainability under guidance 

Implement security features including encryption, access controls, and audit trails for compliance features and customer opt-out mechanisms, ensuring code can be maintained and extended by other engineers 

Contribute to improvements of self-service platforms and control planes by implementing defined enhancements that improve software quality, reliability, and customer experience while learning about system design principles 

A day in the life
You'll participate in engineering standups, providing updates on data storage features and resolving platform blockers. Your hands-on work includes refactoring services for performance, implementing secure data interfaces, and ensuring compliance through quality code and testing. You'll collaborate with scientists and engineers, helping them navigate data access patterns and authorization requirements while mentoring teammates through code reviews. When production issues arise, you investigate root causes to maintain reliable data deletion and opt-out mechanisms. Regular syncs with business application teams help you translate evolving requirements into technical solutions that balance innovation with security and compliance, while also documenting features and training teammates on system lifecycles.

We care deeply about your growth, development, and well-being. You'll collaborate with Senior and Principal Engineers, gaining hands-on experience across a wide range of distributed systems technologies and taking ownership of key areas that impact the entire organization. * Strengthen our Centralized Logging Service by improving log aggregation, search capabilities, storage efficiency, and retention policies across all IMDb properties

The Twitch Ads team manages a comprehensive advertising ecosystem that balances revenue generation with user and advertiser satisfaction. Our team is responsible for driving up Ad Supply quality for Twitch and enabling Ad Demand via various domains including Ads Targeting, Brand Safety&Suitability, Measurement, Privacy and Ads Data Platform.
